        y_anchor = (left_beams[i].position.y + left_beams[i-1].position.y) / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[i], left_beams[i-1], (x_left, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    # Connect middle to top of left strip
    top_left = left_beams[-1]
    anchor_x = (x_left + x_middle) / 2
    anchor_y = (top_left.position.y + middle_beam.position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(top_left, middle_beam, (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    # Connect middle to right beams
    anchor_x = (x_middle + x_right) / 2
    anchor_y = (middle_beam.position.y + right_beams[0].position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(middle_beam, right_beams[0], (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    # Connect right beams vertically
    anchor_y = (right_beams[0].position.y + right_beams[1].position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(right_beams[0], right_beams[1], (x_right, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    # Diagonal bracing for robust coverage
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[0], right_beams[0], ((x_left + x_right) / 2, (left_beams[0].position.y + right_beams[0].position.y) / 2), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[1], right_beams[0], ((x_left + x_right) / 2, (left_beams[1].position.y + right_beams[0].position.y) / 2), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[2], right_beams[1], ((x_left + x_right) / 2, (left_beams[2].position.y + right_beams[1].position.y) / 2), type='rigid')

    return left_beams[0]
